scope: Primary corneal mechanistic candidates screened, not executed or biological corrections

sources.title: Dale et al.1994; A mathematical model of corneal epithelial wound healing
observations: Reaction-diffusion epithelial density/EGF model, underlying source term hypothesis, not independently measured universal mechanism.
Cell-cycle time conversion printed formula and numeric coefficient differ; unresolved, do not silently choose a timescale.
Paper explicitly limits final closure interpretation; front speed does not establish exact closure time.
sources.redistribution: Author-hosted PDF retained privately; full redistribution terms not established.

sources.title: Dale et al.1994; corneal front-speed analysis
observations: Letter and full paper use different printed coefficients.
Visually inspected alpha0.1 differs from OCR; source function uses sigma, not OCR zero.
Printed A560 does not yield unit EGF equilibrium with listed mu13786,cHat3,delta110; discrepancy unresolved, not automatically corrected.
sources.redistribution: Author-hosted PDF retained privately; full redistribution terms not established.

sources.title: Gaffney et al.1999; corneal epithelial cell kinetics
observations: Rat cell-kinetics context is not independent rabbit mechanical wound validation.

other_evidence_screening.decision: US16.1 closure supplement is mouse; rabbit light-scratch safety OCT/IOP does not provide matching full-disc rabbit closure cohort.
Algerbrush0.5mm is tool size; wound diameter not recovered. Do not invent initial geometry or obtain raw data by unauthorized author contact.

next_gate: Recover exact units, equilibria, initial/boundary states and measured covariates, plus another independent heldout study before any model selection. No causal correction established by these sources.
